security.heroTitle: Your money answers to your keys.
security.heroBody: Your device or passkey manager holds the private part of a cryptographic key. Your fingerprint, face, or PIN unlocks it to authorize each movement. GatoPago never receives that private part.
security.whatIsKeyBody1: It's like your house key, but digital: your device or passkey manager protects its private part, and you unlock it with your fingerprint, face, or PIN. There is no GatoPago password to steal or forget.
security.whatIsKeyBody2: Each payment is authorized with a signature created by that key. You can have several (phone, computer); adding a backup key reduces the risk of losing access.
security.faqGatoPagoTitle: What can GatoPago do with my account?
security.faqGatoPagoBody: GatoPago does not hold your keys and cannot sign ordinary payments. The recovery guardian can propose replacing them; the change takes 48 hours, and any active key can cancel it before execution.
security.statusLoadBody: We won't show this state as unprotected or allow keys to be added or removed until we can verify it again.

security.addKeyNeedsWallet: Finish creating your account before adding a backup key.
security.addKeyChainUnavailable: The network is unavailable. You can add a key after verification is restored.

security.keysChainUnavailable: We couldn't verify your onchain keys. No key can be removed until that check is restored.

security.removeBlockedThreshold: Removing a key would leave fewer than the {{threshold}} keys required to authorize activity.
security.keyRenameRetry: The name wasn't changed. Check your connection and try saving it again.
security.keyRemovalPendingBody: The network is confirming the change.
security.keyRemoveRetry: No key was removed. Check your connection and try again.
security.whereStoredBody1: Your device, browser, or password manager chooses where to keep the private part. GatoPago cannot see it, download it, or secretly choose a manager.
security.whereStoredBody2: The system's secure window opens when you create it. If your device offers Google Password Manager, Apple Passwords, or another manager, you can choose from the options shown there.
security.whereStoredBody3: GatoPago stores only the public key and limited metadata to help you recognize it.
security.otherPasskeyOptionsTitle: Another way to store a key
security.otherPasskeyOptionsBody: The primary option uses this device or its passkey manager. If you prefer a separate device, you can register a physical security key.
security.addPhysicalSecurityKeyHelp: Connect or tap a compatible USB, NFC, or Bluetooth key when the system asks.
security.returnBody: After reviewing or adding a key, you can return without starting over.
security.keyDetailsBody: This data helps you recognize and manage the key; it does not grant access to your money.
security.keyPrivateDataNotice: The private part stays in your device, manager, or physical key. GatoPago never receives it.
security.keyProviderNotice: The manager name is inferred from metadata declared by the authenticator. It is informational and is never treated as security proof.

recover.title: Recover your account
recover.promise: Recovery is assisted and never moves your funds. GatoPago can initiate replacement with a new key; a 48-hour delay begins and you can cancel it with any active key.
recover.step1: Create a new access key on this device.
recover.step2: Wait 48 hours. It's a safety period: if someone else tried to take over your account, you'd have time to cancel it.
recover.step3: Activate your new key and you're done.
recover.warning: Important: when the recovery completes, your previous keys will stop working. If you find your old device before activating the new key, you can cancel the request.
recover.ctaConfirmed: Create a key and start recovery
recover.identityConfirmedBody: The link only enabled this step. We have not created a key or changed your account; nothing continues until you press the button.

recover.pendingBody: You'll be able to activate your new key on {{date}}.
recover.pendingWhy: This wait protects your account: if you didn't ask for this, you have 48 hours to cancel it from any device.
recover.pendingOldDevice: Found your old device? You can cancel this request and keep using your account as usual.
recover.cancelConfirm: Tap again to confirm the cancellation
recover.elsewhereBody: This request was started from another device. To continue there, open it on that device. If you no longer have it, cancel and start over from here.
recover.readyBody: When you activate it, your previous keys will stop working on all your devices.
recover.successBody: You can now use GatoPago from this device. Your previous keys no longer work. Your money never moved.
recover.cancelledBody: Everything is as it was: your current keys work normally.
